summary: The audit checks COMPLIT 101, one of COMPLIT 121, 122 or 123, and at least four more COMPLIT courses, 22 units in all, every course letter graded. You check by hand up to 5 units of SLE or independent study the Director of Undergraduate Studies approves, and that no course in the minor also counts toward your major or another minor.

pkncQCu2.why: "Complete at least four additional Comparative Literature courses to bring the overall unit count to meet the minimum unit requirement." Notes: "Up to 5 units of SLE or Independent Study may count with approval from the Director of Undergraduate Studies (DUS)." The minimum is the Bulletin's 22 units in the program; approved SLE or independent study units are moved in by hand. Policies: "Up to 5 units of SLE or Independent Study taught at least partially by a Comparative Literature Department faculty member may be counted towards the elective requirement ... with approval from the Director of Undergraduate Studies (DUS)." COMPLIT 194 (Independent Research) and COMPLIT 299 (Individual Work) are left out of the pool so they count only when moved in, at most 5 units.

program.why: Grading: "All courses must be taken for a letter grade."
